# Keys

<!-- Rendered by scripts/render.ps1 from data/help-registry.tsv and i18n/en.conf. Do not edit. -->

The same registry the help pane (`MOD+F1`) reads. `MOD` is the modifier chosen in the settings
file: `Alt` by default, or the Windows key (`mod=lwin`).

## Window manager
<a id="window-manager"></a>

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `MOD+Enter` | Open a terminal |
| `MOD+R` | The menu: every app, recent file, folder, setting and tool of the Start menu |
| `MOD+E` | Open Neovim in a terminal |
| `MOD+Q` | Close the focused window |
| `MOD+M` | Quit the window manager |
| `MOD+Space` | Toggle floating on the focused window |
| `MOD+F` | Toggle fullscreen |
| `MOD+J` | Toggle the split direction |
| `MOD+L` | Lock the session |
| `MOD+Shift+S` | Screenshot of a selected area |
| `MOD+F1` | This help |
| `MOD+Shift+E` | Power menu |
| `MOD+Shift+T` | Theme picker |
| `MOD+Shift+A` | Ask a local model (Ollama) in a side panel |
| `MOD+V` | Clipboard history |
| `MOD+Shift+R` | Reload the window manager configuration |
| `MOD+Left` | Focus the window to the left |
| `MOD+Right` | Focus the window to the right |
| `MOD+Up` | Focus the window above |
| `MOD+Down` | Focus the window below |
| `MOD+Shift+Left` | Move the window left |
| `MOD+Shift+Right` | Move the window right |
| `MOD+Shift+Up` | Move the window up |
| `MOD+Shift+Down` | Move the window down |
| `MOD+Ctrl+Left` | Make the window narrower |
| `MOD+Ctrl+Right` | Make the window wider |
| `MOD+Ctrl+Up` | Make the window shorter |
| `MOD+Ctrl+Down` | Make the window taller |
| `MOD+1` | Go to workspace 1 |
| `MOD+2` | Go to workspace 2 |
| `MOD+3` | Go to workspace 3 |
| `MOD+4` | Go to workspace 4 |
| `MOD+5` | Go to workspace 5 |
| `MOD+6` | Go to workspace 6 |
| `MOD+7` | Go to workspace 7 |
| `MOD+8` | Go to workspace 8 |
| `MOD+9` | Go to workspace 9 |
| `MOD+0` | Go to workspace 10 |
| `MOD+Shift+1` | Carry the window to workspace 1 |
| `MOD+Shift+2` | Carry the window to workspace 2 |
| `MOD+Shift+3` | Carry the window to workspace 3 |
| `MOD+Shift+4` | Carry the window to workspace 4 |
| `MOD+Shift+5` | Carry the window to workspace 5 |
| `MOD+Shift+6` | Carry the window to workspace 6 |
| `MOD+Shift+7` | Carry the window to workspace 7 |
| `MOD+Shift+8` | Carry the window to workspace 8 |
| `MOD+Shift+9` | Carry the window to workspace 9 |
| `MOD+Shift+0` | Carry the window to workspace 10 |
| `MOD+.` | Next workspace in use |
| `MOD+,` | Previous workspace in use |

## Browser
<a id="browser"></a>

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl+T` | New tab |
| `Ctrl+W` | Close the tab |
| `Ctrl+L` | Go to the address bar |
| `Ctrl+Shift+T` | Reopen the last closed tab |
| `Ctrl+F` | Find in the page |

## Shell
<a id="shell"></a>

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl+R` | Search the command history |
| `Home` | Start of the line |
| `End` | End of the line |
| `Esc` | Clear the line |
| `Ctrl+C` | Interrupt the running command |
| `Tab` | Complete a command or path |

## Editor
<a id="editor"></a>

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `Space` | Leader key |
| `Space+F` | Find files |
| `Space+/` | Search text in the project |
| `Space+E` | File explorer |
| `G+D` | Go to definition |

## System
<a id="system"></a>

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `Win+L` | Lock the session |
| `Win+V` | Clipboard history |
| `Win+Shift+S` | Screenshot of an area (Snipping Tool) |
| `Win+Tab` | All windows and desktops |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Esc` | Task Manager |
| `Win+I` | Windows Settings |
| `Win+.` | Emoji and symbols |
